main_text.l: prout ex nunc, de nullitate dico, deque grauamine, & iniustitia appello ad quem, vel ad quos ex
nunc prout ex tunc, iudicium rectum non suspectum spectat, spectabitque, in nullo, ad nullum-
quem[?] me adstringens: paratus tamen semper ad satisfactionem omni poscenti me rationem de ea, quae
in me est, spe, atque fide, sed cum modestia, & timore conscientiam habens bonam, vt in eo, quod
detrahunt mihi confundantur, qui calumniantur meam bonam in Christo conuersationem:
Melius est enim, vt bene faciens (si voluntas Dei velit) pati quam male faciens. Vtinam sibi ipsis,
& vniuerso gregi attenderent, & nō spiritibus erroris: nec intenderent mandatis hominum auer-
santium se à veritate, sed neque fabulis, & genealogiis interminatis, quae quaestionem praestant
magis, quam ædificationem Dei, quae est in fide.
VI.
Intendere autem, atque attendere diligenter vos velim, Sancti Reuerendissimique Patres,
compresbyteri, confratres, ac commilitones mei in Christo, quae opposita sunt ante faciem vestram.
Quod etsi vos ipsi non intenderitis, & attenderitis, intendet, attendetque certè Deus, at-
que videns, nequirensque in adiutorium meum intendet, quemadmodum, sua bonitate, cle-
mentia, & iustitia, altero ab hoc anno intedens, attedens, videns q;[?] ac nequirés, è medio sublatis,
qui iniustè iniquitatem fecerunt in me, (quibusdam tamen relictis ad eorum correctione-
m, meam vero exercitationem) mirabiliter adiuuit. Cui omnis honor, gloria, & Imperium, nunc
& semper.
Datum Venetiis ex Sacro Sanctissimi Domini Redemptoris Nostri Conuentu, Serenissimae
huius Reipublicae patronatu, Anno ab ipsius Domini Nostri Iesu Christi Incarnatione 1606.
Indict. quarta, die vero Nouembris 25. Principatus Serenissimi, & Sapientissimi, perinde ac Chri-
stianissimi, Domini Leonardi, Diuina miseratione Ducis Venetiarum, &c. II. Anno I.

page.notes: Right margin notes, as printed in order: I.Petri 3.; Act. 10.; I. Tim.4.; Tit.1.; 1.Tim.2. (first paragraph); 2.Par.34.; Psalm.69.; & 76.; Psalm.65.; Malac.3.; Psalm.118. (second paragraph). Their exact placement in the text is approximate. Doubtful readings: "quem[?]me" at the line break; "videns q;[?]" and "altero ab hoc anno intedens" are hard to read at the scan. The line-number marks 10, 15 and 20 are as printed; the 10 is partly obscured by a dot. The left-margin fragments are not transcribed: they are the edge of the neighbouring page. The ornament at the top centre is a printer's decoration, not text. The mark "SS 3" at mid-right is printed but sits away from the foot, so its reading as a gathering signature is uncertain. The left-margin notes are cut off at the image edge, so each line starts mid-word and is given as far as it can be read. The main text block is not visible in this part of the page. The digitiser's watermark at the bottom right is left out.
